source.title: Tailwind CSS v4.0 - Tailwind CSS
source.description: Why v4 replaced `tailwind.config.js` with CSS config and auto-detects content, and which utilities and variants it introduced.

source.title: Tailwind CSS v4.1: Text shadows, masks, and tons more - Tailwind CSS
source.description: What's new in 4.1: older-Safari rendering fallbacks, colored drop shadows, long-word wrapping, touch-device and form-validation variants, overflow-safe centering.

source.title: Install Tailwind CSS with Next.js - Tailwind CSS
source.description: Six-step setup: install `@tailwindcss/postcss`, create `postcss.config.mjs`, add `@import "tailwindcss"` to `app/globals.css`, then use utility classes.

source.title: Editor setup - Getting started - Tailwind CSS
source.description: Fix editor warnings on `@theme`/`@source` at-rules, IntelliSense for VS Code, Cursor, Zed and JetBrains, and auto-sorting classes with the Prettier plugin.

source.title: Compatibility - Getting started - Tailwind CSS
source.description: Minimum browser versions, why not to use Sass/Less/Stylus, and fixing `@apply` in CSS modules or Vue/Svelte/Astro `<style>` blocks with `@reference`.

source.title: Styling with utility classes - Core concepts - Tailwind CSS
source.description: Why utilities beat inline styles, managing repeated class lists, and why conflicting classes ignore their order in the attribute.

source.title: Hover, focus, and other states - Core concepts - Tailwind CSS
source.description: Searchable table of every variant, styling from a parent's, sibling's or descendant's state, and why `peer` must come first.

source.title: Colors - Core concepts - Tailwind CSS
source.description: Make colors transparent with `bg-black/75`, use `--color-*` variables in custom CSS, add or replace palette colors; plus every default OKLCH value.

source.title: Adding custom styles - Core concepts - Tailwind CSS
source.description: When built-in classes fall short: one-off arbitrary values, base and component CSS, and authoring your own `@utility` and `@custom-variant`.

source.title: Detecting classes in source files - Core concepts - Tailwind CSS
source.description: Why dynamically built class names generate no CSS, and using `@source` to scan extra paths, ignore others, or safelist classes.

source.title: Functions and directives - Core concepts - Tailwind CSS
source.description: Syntax lookup for every at-rule and CSS function, including `@reference` in component styles and loading v3 JS configs or plugins.

source.title: Dark mode - Core concepts - Tailwind CSS
source.description: Toggle dark mode manually via `@custom-variant` and a class or `data-theme`, and build a light/dark/system switch without a flash.

source.title: Responsive design - Core concepts - Tailwind CSS
source.description: Default breakpoints, why `sm:` doesn't target mobile, `max-*` ranges, custom `--breakpoint-*` values, and `@container` queries including named containers and sizes.

source.title: Theme
source.description: Define, override or remove `@theme` variables, which namespace creates which utility, fixing `var()` references with `inline`; plus a searchable list of every default value.

source.title: font-family - Typography - Tailwind CSS
source.description: Add custom fonts via `--font-*` theme variables and `@font-face`, why Google Fonts `@import` must come first, and arbitrary `font-[…]` values.

source.title: Preflight
source.description: Base stylesheet built on modern-normalize that `@import "tailwindcss"` injects: why headings, lists and images lose browser defaults, fixing widgets its border reset breaks, and disabling it.

source.title: Upgrade guide - Getting started - Tailwind CSS
source.description: Migrate from v3 via `npx @tailwindcss/upgrade` or by hand, plus every breaking change: renamed `shadow`/`rounded` scales, default border and ring colors, `@utility`.

source.title: background-image - Backgrounds - Tailwind CSS
source.description: Mostly gradients: linear, radial and conic, with color stops, positions and interpolation; plus image URLs.

source.title: backdrop-filter: blur() - Filters - Tailwind CSS
source.description: Frosted-glass effect: blur the content behind a translucent element, like a card over an image.

source.title: animation - Transitions & Animation - Tailwind CSS
source.description: Animate loading spinners, notification pings, skeleton loaders and scroll hints; respect reduced motion; define custom `@keyframes`.

source.title: font-size - Typography - Tailwind CSS
source.description: Rem/px sizes of `text-xs` through `text-9xl`, their default line-heights, and setting line-height inline with `text-sm/6`.

source.title: box-shadow - Effects - Tailwind CSS
source.description: Inset shadows, solid `ring`/`inset-ring` borders, colored shadows, and why default shadows look faint; mostly a class table.
